pages.title: Rooms
pages.content:
Five rooms sit under the eaves of Kumoi Lodge. In November three are open (Ridge, Larch and the Bunk Loft); the Cairn Room and the Window Room reopen on 26 December. All prices are per night, half board (supper and breakfast).

Ridge Room

A double bed under the eaves with an east-facing window over the clouds, 18 m². Two guests, half board €210.

Larch Room

Twin beds, larch-panelled walls and a small writing desk, 16 m². Two guests, half board €190.

Bunk Loft

Six sturdy timber bunks for trail walkers, 30 m². Half board €62 per bunk.

Cairn Room

A double bed plus two singles for families, 26 m², up to four guests, half board €320. Reopens 26 December.

Window Room

A single bed with a desk set in a deep window recess, 11 m², one guest, half board €110. Reopens 26 December.

pages.title: The Stay
pages.content:
Kumoi Lodge was built in 1931 as a herders’ hut and opened as a lodge in 1964. The present keepers have looked after it since 2009.

How a night is held

  • Rooms are ready from 15:00; please arrive by 17:00 (the desk is open 08:00 to 20:00).
  • The wood-fired tub is lit at 16:30 (€18 for 45 minutes per room).
  • Supper is at 18:30 and the stove is banked at 21:30.
  • Breakfast is at 07:00; check-out is by 10:00 and bags can stay until 14:00.

Ines Halvorsen keeps the lodge, Tomas Reyes-Bauer cooks supper and Clémence Aubry answers every request within 24 hours.

pages.title: The Table
pages.content:
One pot, one long timber table. Supper is served family-style at 18:30; breakfast is at 07:00.

Supper at 18:30

A single pot cooked by Tomas, such as barley and lentil stew, with sourdough from the morning bake, mountain cheese and a baked apple. Vegetarian always; other needs with three days’ notice.

Breakfast at 07:00

Porridge with honey, soft eggs, Amara’s warm bread and butter, preserves, coffee and tea. A packed lunch for the trail is €12.

pages.title: Rates & Booking
pages.content:
Prices are per night, half board (supper and breakfast), in euros.

  • Ridge Room, 2 guests: €210
  • Larch Room, 2 guests: €190
  • Cairn Room, up to 4 guests: €320
  • Window Room, 1 guest: €110
  • Bunk Loft, per bunk: €62
  • Packed lunch for the trail: €12
  • Wood-fired tub, 45 minutes, per room: €18

How to book

  • Choose dates and a room.
  • Send a request by email to stay@kumoilodge.example.
  • The keeper confirms within 24 hours and asks for a 30% deposit.
  • Arrive by 17:00. Free cancellation up to 14 days before arrival.

We are open 1 May to 30 November and 26 December to 15 March. The next free night is Friday 14 November.

pages.title: Walks & Weather
pages.content:
Lio Brandt watches the track and the sky on Harrow Ridge. Ask at the desk before you set out; he can tell you which way the cloud is moving and when to turn back.

From the door

  • Vell Pass loop, about 3 hours.
  • Ridge line to the cairn, about 90 minutes each way.
  • A short evening walk to the dusk viewpoint, 20 minutes.

Boots dry overnight in the boot room by the stove. A packed lunch is €12.

pages.title: Getting here
pages.content:
Kumoi Lodge, Harrow Ridge Track 4, 8742 Vell, at 1,640 m above the Vell valley.

Leave the car at the gate car park at Vell Pass (1,420 m). From there it is a 2.2 km track, about 35 minutes on foot. If the track is iced, the keeper will fetch you in about 10 minutes.

pages.title: Keepers
pages.content:
Seven people keep the lodge through the season.

  • Ines Halvorsen, keeper since 2009.
  • Tomas Reyes-Bauer, co-keeper and supper cook.
  • Amara Okoye, bread and breakfast.
  • Lio Brandt, track, weather and walks.
  • Yusuf Demir, wood, stove and repairs.
  • Clémence Aubry, bookings and the desk.
  • Sofia Marchetti, rooms and linen.

pages.title: Notes
pages.content:
Short notes from the keepers: what is open, what the weather did, what came out of the oven.

In November three rooms are open: Ridge, Larch and the Bunk Loft. The Cairn Room and the Window Room reopen on 26 December. We are closed 1 to 25 December and 16 March to 30 April.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content:
Write to stay@kumoilodge.example or call +00 41 555 0164. The desk is open 08:00 to 20:00 and Clémence Aubry answers every request within 24 hours.
